name: Penzlin (Germany)
description: Vertically divided red and yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Penzlin (a black bull's head on yellow and red and white bars).
history: The flag was designed by the Schwerin heraldist Heinz Kippnick and approved by the Ministry of the Interior on 24 April 2003.

features.role: Penzlin arms — bull's head and bars
